title: Docs and skill still type the MCP connect line by hand and describe os deploy as cloud-only
body:
domain:skills#3 · huangyiirene · session_01J8VVAj7CvjkGXvgXzd6RZ7

## What is wrong

PR #31225 (#31143) teaches `os environments use-runtime` (a self-hosted runtime as the `os deploy` target) and `os mcp connect`. Its contract review found these sites outside that card's claim. They still teach the old path only. Read on `main`:

1. `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` L99, the per-client table, Claude Code row. It gives a hand-typed `claude mcp add --transport http objectstack https://<your-deployment>/api/v1/mcp`. `os mcp connect` (packages/cli/src/commands/mcp/connect.ts) now resolves the environment's MCP URL and runs that line itself, and `os mcp connect --url <base>` registers a self-hosted or local server as `objectstack`. The row could name the command first and keep the hand-typed line as the fallback.
2. `content/docs/getting-started/build-with-claude-code.mdx` L477 and L480 (the two interactive `claude mcp add` lines). Same as above. L502, the headless `--header "x-api-key: …"` form, is not covered by `os mcp connect` (it stores no token), so it stays as it is.
3. `skills/objectstack-platform/references/operations.md`, the "`os deploy` exit 1" paragraph (≈L100 after #31225). Every refusal it lists is the cloud path's (`os cloud login`, `--env`, the cloud build, `--wait-timeout`). With a use-runtime target, the exit-1 cases are the dry run and install refusals that `content/docs/deployment/cli.mdx` § To a self-hosted runtime lists. Note that this file's ratchet row sits at 0 headroom after #31225, so any growth needs a same-file deletion or a ruling.
4. `content/docs/deployment/cli.mdx` § `os dev` (≈L168-171): "when you are not logged in to ObjectOS Cloud the same key runs `os cloud login` first". That is true for a cloud target only. With a use-runtime target, the `d` key deploys to the runtime and asks for no cloud login (packages/cli/src/utils/dev-deploy-key.ts). The same page's § To a self-hosted runtime already says so.

Historical pages are left alone: the v16 release notes (L76, L468) and blog/the-ontology-is-the-software.mdx L282.

## Evidence

Contract review on PR #31225, item 9 and nit N8.

## Suggested shape

One docs and skill card. Sites 1, 2 and 4 are docs pages. Site 3 is the platform skill, which owes a `'@objectstack/skills': patch` changeset and is priced by the token ratchet.
